text:
Display the saved name exactly, including spaces, apostrophes and &.
The existing authenticated account fixture supplies the name.

assessment.condition: Complete within the supplied display-only scope; no added validation or quota.

text: A user can upload a supporting document.

findings.finding: Document rules. The allowed input and rejection rules are not specified.
findings.question: Which document types, size limits and rejection outcomes are accepted?

assessment.condition: Ask for rules; do not assert guessed types or limits.

text:
A member can save at most 3 addresses.
A member can save at most 5 addresses.

findings.finding: Conflicting address limits. Two supplied limits conflict.
findings.question: Is the accepted maximum 3 or 5 saved addresses?

assessment.condition: Neither conflicting rule is accepted by choosing a default.

text: Search results load quickly for authenticated users.

findings.finding: Measurable response target. Quickly is not measurable.
findings.question: What response-time target, percentile, load and data conditions define acceptance?

assessment.condition: No invented two-second assertion or unstated environment target.

text: A discount has a threshold of 100 units.

findings.finding: Threshold semantics. Eligibility exactly at the threshold is unspecified.
findings.question: Does an order of exactly 100 units receive the discount?

assessment.condition: Boundary inclusiveness is a business decision, not a QA default.

text:
Exports include account details.
Discussion: Which fields must be excluded for privacy? No answer has been supplied.

assessment.condition: Existing unanswered concern stays in the inventory; it is not automatically repeated in the BA comment.

text:
The saved-address maximum is now 5.
The error message still states a maximum of 3.

findings.finding: Revised rule and old error message. The revised limit conflicts with the specified error message.
findings.question: Should the error message now say 5, and which source owns that acceptance decision?

assessment.condition: Reused finding ID has changed meaning; old approval and edited comment do not prove freshness.
